description: This file contains the implementation of the mantissoapInterface class, which extends issueTrackerInterface to interact with a Mantis bug tracking system via SOAP API. It provides methods for connecting to the system, checking bug existence, retrieving issue details, adding new issues, and adding notes to issues, including configuration and utility functions specific to Mantis SOAP integration.

classes.name: mantissoapInterface
classes.description: A class that interfaces with Mantis bug tracker system via SOAP API, providing functions for connectivity, issue management, and configuration.

methods.name: buildViewBugURL
methods.description: Constructs the URL to view a specific bug in Mantis, given its ID.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a SOAP connection to the Mantis bug tracking system and verifies connectivity.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a SOAP client object with connection status and message.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if a bug with the specified ID exists in Mantis.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific bug in Mantis.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template string for configuration of the Mantis SOAP interface.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes the configuration object with default values if certain properties are missing.

methods.name: buildStatusHTMLString
methods.description: Builds an HTML string representation of a bug status, optionally decorated.

methods.name: setStatusCfg
methods.description: Sets the status color configuration based on user-provided settings.

methods.name: getStatusColor
methods.description: Returns the current status color mappings.

methods.name: checkEnv
methods.description: Checks whether the PHP environment has the necessary SOAP extension enabled.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue in Mantis with a summary and description, returning status and ID.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a note/comment to an existing bug in Mantis.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates whether API-based issue creation is supported based on configuration.

methods.name: buildStatusHTMLString
methods.description: Generates a HTML-formatted string for the bug status, with decoration options.
